probe_history: An initial single-shot preview held auto progression; it was stopped and Editor/preferences restored. Full entry was separated from single-shot preview gates.
A probe counted the prologue end sentinel as a tenth shot; CurrentShot now stays on the last real plate at completion.
Story Auto originally re-enabled on return through Title; Auto choice is now checkpointed and first entry reading starts manual. Successful coverage includes all 107 lines.
Stopping an early prologue exposed an already-destroyed cinematic root in Dispose; the null guard is verified by clean paused/prologue exits.
An early setup probe failed before establishing its baseline; it is not counted as a pass. Later runs independently established/restored their own snapshots.
A feedback note saved successfully before a window-reload reflection lookup failed; its persisted ID was inspected and reused. No duplicate note was created.
limits: All UI input proof uses typed Editor events, not physical pointer/touch.
Cloud read/write, response loss and activation rejection were explicit memory fixtures; no real backend/provider requests were sent.
Successful final activation was the embedded/up-to-date logical runtime reload; signed remote staging, Android OS relaunch/process-death and live account acceptance remain open.
Earlier capture runs predate the explicit REVIEW FIXTURE prefix/memory-only metadata field; final four Finish captures carry both.
PlayMode audio tests pass; their existing empty-clip time warnings are not new entry failures.
Normal Home/system presentation and server-sessioned campaign operation/recovery remain rebuild work.
